plain_description: **Give your team a self-hosted AI coding assistant to help write and edit code.** Run it on your own infrastructure as an alternative to GitHub Copilot. Connect it to supported code editors and use its OpenAPI interface to integrate with existing tools.
technical_description: Tabby is an open-source, self-hosted AI coding assistant and on-premises alternative to GitHub Copilot. The README describes code completion and chat, editor extensions, an OpenAPI interface, and support for consumer-grade GPUs. It can run as a server using Docker; the example uses CUDA and specifies code and chat models.
title: Tabby
